title: Courtesy Reships for Strip Refills Delivered but Not Received — Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
**Policy.** When the proof of delivery shows the program's latest strip refill as delivered but the customer reports it not received, Larkfield sends a no-charge courtesy reship under the replacement terms of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months are fewer than the tier's courtesy reship limit. A replacement for a package lost in transit, damaged in transit or defective is outside this policy.

**Prerequisite clause.** A courtesy reship for a program that carries a past-due amount is not shipped until an approved payment plan request stands on the program.

As a record state: while the program shows a past-due amount, the courtesy reship waits until a payment plan request with the status approved stands on the program.

## Tool: `ship_courtesy_reship_05d6f35c`

**What it does.** Sends a no-charge courtesy reship of blood glucose test strips (item A4253) on a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program enrollment for a refill package the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive. One call records the replacement shipment on the enrollment's shipment history, shipped today against the named original refill with the reason `delivered_not_received`, 50 test strips per unit as its pieces; it draws no authorized units and is never billed. The customer can afterwards see the reship on the shipment history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `ship_courtesy_reship_05d6f35c`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bgm_program_id` | the reference number of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program enrollment, as returned by the enrollment lookup | identifier |
| `original_bgm_shipment_id` | the reference number of the refill shipment record the customer did not receive, as returned by the shipment-history lookup | identifier |
| `units` | the number of billing units of test strips reshipped (one unit is 50 strips); the pieces are recorded as 50 strips for every unit | integer count of whole billing units |
| `shipping_method` | how the reship travels: `standard` when it goes by ordinary ground shipping; `expedited_no_charge` when it goes by two-day shipping that Larkfield pays for; `expedited` when the customer asked for two-day shipping and pays for it | one of the three values |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new reship reference number, the ship date in YYYY-MM-DD form, the integer billing units and pieces sent, the shipping method and the original refill reference number. Its presence means the reship left the warehouse.
